summary: Revision 3 addresses the prior P2 shared-badge composition gap. AC-2 and the Figma sequence require actual nested StatusBadge instances with shared 24px text-hug geometry and badge-owned color bindings. The registered components.json contract now gives every ToolCall and PermissionRequest parent variant a StatusBadge child, semantic state, and visible label; ToolCall tones follow the referenced StatusBadge state bindings, while PermissionRequest specifies per-state tone overrides, including execution-neutral approved. Parent status color bindings were removed, and system.md repeats the composition rule. The five-family scope, unchanged Button variants and 44-variant inventory, source-first design-spec gate, per-page Light/Dark verification, and separate runtime evidence boundary remain coherent. This is a plan judgment; actual Figma instances and rendered behavior require subsequent design-spec handoff and implementation verification.
